stem.text: Which statement describes how the molecular structure of starch is suited to its function?

A.text: Amylose has a branched structure and amylopectin is coiled to give a compact molecule for transport.

B.text: In the breakdown of amylose and amylopectin, many condensation reactions release stored energy.

C.text: In the formation of amylose and amylopectin, many hydrolysis reactions allow the release of stored energy.

D.text: The amylose-amylopectin complex is insoluble and does not affect the water potential of the cell.
